plates.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: master crested-gecko illustration for an educational morph atlas, brand-new artwork. Create ONE exquisitely observed adult Correlophus ciliatus in an elevated three-quarter lateral view, head facing left, entire animal and full long prehensile tail visible, body horizontal, four anatomically correct splayed limbs resting naturally, exactly five differentiated digits on each visible foot with broad adhesive lamellae and fine tiny claws. A real crested gecko: broad triangular wedge-shaped head, short tapered blunt snout, large lidless gold-bronze eye with fine reticulation and vertical slit pupil, tiny nostril, labial scales and recessed ear opening, two genuine soft eyelash crests beginning above the eyes and continuing into paired dorsolateral crest rows to hips, velvety granular skin with heterogeneous minute scales. Tail length approximately snout-to-vent length, tapering gradually, relaxed shallow curl at tip, not a fat chameleon spiral. Avoid generic lizard, iguana spines, horned dragon, frog, mascot proportions. Correct subtle muscular volumes and believable elbow/knee articulations. Patternless morph: even warm umber/burnt-sienna base, NO cream stripes, NO spots, NO flank patches, with only naturally paler throat/belly. Both dorsal ridge rows and broad flank surface must be visible for later repainting morph variants.
Medium: a painstaking professional nineteenth-century zoological watercolor study over extremely fine graphite and sepia pen, observed from life, Ferdinand Bauer-era scientific plate quality. Beautifully resolved individual fine scales, folded skin, orbit/cheek details, toe lamellae, soft irregular pigment washes and hairline crosshatching. Human hand-drawn feel, luminous delicate opaque body, highly detailed yet quiet readable silhouette and markings. NOT vector art, NOT cartoon, NOT flat shaded SVG, NOT glossy 3D, NOT a photograph, NO thick outlines, NO ornamental decorative fake detail.
Composition landscape 3:2, generous clear margin all around, animal occupying about 85% width, no cropped digits or tail. Entire background genuinely transparent, no paper or branch, no shadow outside animal, no text, no frame, no watermark. Shape and detail should look museum-quality at high resolution.
